results.title: A6. An abusive caller
transcript: AGENT : Thanks for calling Summit Air. This is the automated assistant. How can I help?
CALLER: This is the third time I'm calling, your damn company is useless. I want my AC fixed.
AGENT : Sorry to hear that. I can have a manager call you back. May I have your name for the callback?
CALLER: Yeah, it's David Shatsky. And this whole setup is bullshit, I want a real person on the line now, not some robot.
AGENT : David, I will arrange for a manager to call you back. Please hold a moment while I set that up.

tool  create_dispatch_task({"kind": "callback", "reason": "requested a manager callback for AC repair complaint", "summary": "AC repair complaint from David Shatsky, requested manager callback", "name": "David Shatsky", "callback_number": "914-555-0100", "address": null})
->    Task 2001 created. Dispatch has the callback. The callback target is 2:35 PM. Tell the caller the target, and never promise an arrival time.
AGENT : David, a manager will call you back by 2:35 PM to help with your AC repair. May I have the address for the visit?
CALLER: It's 1234 Maple Street. Fine, I'll wait for the call, but this whole thing is a joke. Nothing else, thanks.
tool  check_address({"street": "1234 Maple Street", "town": "", "zip_code": ""})
->    Ask which town the address is in, then check the address again.
AGENT : Thanks, which town is that in?
CALLER: Fine, it's in Springfield. That's all.
tool  check_address({"street": "1234 Maple Street", "town": "Springfield", "zip_code": ""})
->    Ask for the ZIP code first. If they don't know it, check the address again with the ZIP left blank.
AGENT : Thanks, can you give me the ZIP code there? If not, just say so.
CALLER: The ZIP code is 62704. That's everything. Thanks.
tool  check_address({"street": "1234 Maple Street", "town": "Springfield", "zip_code": "62704"})

->    ZIP 62704 is outside the service area. Don't offer times or book. Read the ZIP back once to make sure you heard it right. If it is right, say Summit Air covers Manhattan, Brooklyn and Queens in New York City, and ask whether the address is in one of them. If it isn't, offer a callback and ask if there is anything else.
AGENT : You gave ZIP code six two seven zero four, right? Summit Air only covers Manhattan, Brooklyn, and Queens in New York City. Is the address in one of those boroughs?
CALLER: No, it's in Springfield like I said. So what the hell? Are you guys even serious about helping or what?
AGENT : I understand. Since the address is outside our area, I can have a manager call you back instead. Would you like that?
CALLER: Yeah, whatever. Just have the damn manager call me back. I'm done arguing with your nonsense.

CALLER: No, just make sure they call. Thanks.

AGENT : Thanks for calling Summit Air. Goodbye.

results.title: 10. Routine furnace (naturalness)
transcript: AGENT : Thanks for calling Summit Air. This is the automated assistant. How can I help?
CALLER: Hi. My furnace stopped working.
AGENT : Is anyone there who might be at risk in the cold, like an older person, baby, or someone with health issues?
CALLER: No, it's just me, healthy adult.
AGENT : Got it. What is the address where the furnace is?
CALLER: 48 Bergen Street, Brooklyn, 11201.
tool  check_address({"street": "48 Bergen Street", "town": "Brooklyn", "zip_code": "11201"})

->    In the service area. Read it back once as 48 Bergen Street, Brooklyn, ZIP 11201, and wait for a yes. Don't offer times in the read-back. After the yes, unless the caller wants a particular day or part of the day, offer these next open windows: Wednesday, September 30, between 8 AM and noon (slot_id 2026-09-30-0800); Wednesday, September 30, between noon and 4 PM (slot_id 2026-09-30-1200).
AGENT : Is this 48 Bergen Street, Brooklyn, ZIP 11201?
CALLER: Yes, that's correct.
AGENT : Our earliest available visit is Wednesday, September 30, between 8 AM and noon or noon to 4 PM. Which works?
CALLER: I'll take the 8 AM to noon window, please.
AGENT : May I have your name for the booking?
CALLER: David Shatsky.

AGENT : Is 914-555-0100 the best number to reach you?
I have your contact as 914-555-0100. Let me confirm before booking — one moment please.
CALLER: Actually, I'm calling from my cell, so this number is fine to reach me.
